title: NTUB1 rep1
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from cells using Trizol reagent (Life Technologies, Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA), according to the manufacturer's instructions | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocols
data_processing: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence, then mapped to Hg19 whole genome using STAR v2.7.2b | Reads number were calculated using RSEM v1.3.1. | Assembly: Hg19 | Supplementary files format and content: Matrix table with raw count for every gene and every sample
